content.text: {"assertions":[{"evidence":[{"quote":"朝凪の主担当は西部室である。","unit_id":"source-unit-d78f720dbe8fa7031f800233961b03b2411d53578b19b0455060f514e600ad27"}],"object":"西部室","predicate":"managedBy","status":"asserted","subject":"朝凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"朝凪の主担当は東部室ではない。","unit_id":"source-unit-4eb875fd00e280c2307c8ea295543fec58bff6eed53e3d644afd8ba3e77cfab6"}],"object":"東部室","predicate":"managedBy","status":"denied","subject":"朝凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"朝凪の予算額は1200000円ではない。","unit_id":"source-unit-3385297f96ad4a0f5156f67dfd7f3c07af2f9a390d74c393652f4761e4232c13"}],"object":"1200000円","predicate":"budgetYen","status":"denied","subject":"朝凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"星凪の支援担当は東部室である。","unit_id":"source-unit-374d050eb17eda61dffcb17f79e99e41b190ac4e0095e8e0e15f700c99e5589f"}],"object":"東部室","predicate":"supportedBy","status":"asserted","subject":"星凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"星凪の承認担当の候補は審査室と品質室であり、いずれを採用するか決定していない。","unit_id":"source-unit-809abf19d777308bafc377fac75063f864be0b5e418821c393999b6d664554e6"}],"object":null,"predicate":"approvedBy","status":"ambiguous","subject":"星凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"月凪の主担当は企画室である。","unit_id":"source-unit-ce8ea8fcb0b2061ee089e4be5e19c77090dfd7a9cbb447474fcdb1c4cad8b569"}],"object":"企画室","predicate":"managedBy","status":"asserted","subject":"月凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"月凪の予算額は2400000円である。","unit_id":"source-unit-cf3843277667406044d2d1381f1cb88fe5fa5c95290c26689c3034d210770d4d"}],"object":"2400000円","predicate":"budgetYen","status":"asserted","subject":"月凪"},{"evidence":[{"quote":"灯台の主担当は在庫運用室である。","unit_id":"source-unit-0ba4618b3b2842a6ab1909c3f1959cb76230c0c057d7f1eca8d573a23ca0ef23"}],"object":"在庫運用室","predicate":"managedBy","status":"asserted","subject":"灯台"}]}
